subject: Exec sync: VP/CIO attendance + backup coverage for OliveTech demo
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@olivetech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech - Sales Ops <salesops@olivetech.com>
Date: 2029-05-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo - exec availability

Hi Sean / Rachel,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after our discovery call. We’re eager to see Redwood’s live demo focused on cost-optimizing inference for our ML platform. Two asks from my side:

1) Can a senior sponsor (VP of Infrastructure or CIO) join the first 30 minutes?
2) We need a clear backup plan in case our VP has to drop — who from Redwood can cover the executive pitch and, separately, the technical deep dive?

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue May 21, 10:00–10:45
- Wed May 22, 14:00–14:45

Audience: myself, Aisha Khan (platform lead), 3 engineers, and the VP (TBD).

If those windows don’t work we can be flexible next week. Also attaching a quick attendee spreadsheet for context (OliveTech_Roles.csv).

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Senior Manager, Cloud Partnerships
OliveTech

[Attachment: OliveTech_Roles.csv (CSV)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo - exec availability

Thanks Jordan — looping internal sponsors.

Rachel / Marissa: quick proposal below so we can respond to Jordan with a concrete plan:

- Confirmed Presenter (exec intro): Rachel Kim (first 20m) — will cover value props and business outcomes.
- Backup exec coverage: Marissa Cole will pick up the executive narrative if Rachel needs to move to another meeting.
- Technical deep dive: Monica Patel will lead the 20m technical portion (KV cache, batching, quantization profiles).

I’m attaching the current VP-deck-v2.pdf and a demo runbook (Demo-runbook-OLV.docx). Please review and flag any objections to roles/timing by EOD Friday.

Proposed final time: Wed May 22, 14:00–14:45 PT (one calendar invite; run of show will call out first 20m exec + 20m tech + 5m Q&A).

If you want to hold Tue May 21 as a backup, we can include that in the reply as an alternate.

Sean
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: VP-deck-v2.pdf (PDF), Demo-runbook-OLV.docx (DOCX)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo - exec availability

On Wed, May 15, 2029 at 08:12 AM Jordan Price <jordan.price@olivetech.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick follow-up after our discovery call.

Looks good to me — I’ll lead the exec intro and keep it tight. A couple of quick asks before I confirm:

- Can Sean add a one-slide agenda to the invite so the VP knows we’ll cover cost impact up-front?
- Monica, will you be able to demo the quantization recommendation flow live or should we show screenshots + follow with a short recorded snippet?

If we say Wed 14:00 PT, I can commit to the first 20 minutes; Marissa will be on standby for the handoff language.

Thanks — I’ll draft the reply to Jordan once we lock the agenda slide.

Rachel
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@olivetech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@olivetech.com>, OliveTech - Sales Ops <salesops@olivetech.com>
Date: 2029-05-16T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sync: VP/CIO attendance + backup coverage for OliveTech demo

Sean / Rachel — Wed May 22, 14:00–14:45 PT works for the VP; she plans to join for the first ~20 minutes and may need to drop for a conflict.

A few notes from our side:
- VP wants to hear specific unit-cost savings (per-token/per-request) and the path to predictable latency for our bursty inference workloads.
- Please include a 2-minute customer-impact slide followed by the technical outline.

Attendees (confirmed): Jordan Price (me), Aisha Khan (platform lead), Dr. Kevin Lu (VP, Infrastructure), 3 engineers.

We’ve uploaded a very short attendee sheet and internal org peek — see OliveTech_Roles.csv attached.

If you can send the invite with the agenda slide and run of show, we’ll add it to the VP calendar.

Jordan
Senior Manager, Cloud Partnerships
OliveTech

[Attachment: OliveTech_Roles.csv (CSV)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@olivetech.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@olivetech.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, OliveTech - Sales Ops <salesops@olivetech.com>
Date: 2029-05-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed May 22 14:00–14:45 PT — OliveTech demo (run of show + backups)

Thanks Jordan — confirmed on our side. Final run of show below (will include as the first slide in the invite):

1) Welcome & customer impact (Rachel) — 0:00–0:02
2) Executive value + unit economics (Rachel) — 0:02–0:20
3) Technical deep dive (Monica) — 0:20–0:40
4) Short wrap + next steps / procurement checklist (Sean / Marissa) — 0:40–0:45

Backups / handoff rules:
- If Rachel needs to leave early, Marissa will take the executive value segment (0:02–0:20).
- If Monica’s live demo runs into issues, Sean will have a recorded 6-minute clip queued (see Demo-runbook-OLV.docx).

I’ve attached the agenda slide and the VP-deck-v2.pdf. I’ll send the calendar invite to all confirmed attendees and include the HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.com/deal/OLV-2029-0437

See you Wed — Sean
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
